proposal.summary: Duplicator WordPress plugin before 1.4.7 exposes system information to unauthenticated visitors, including server software, PHP version, and full filesystem path to the site.
proposal.cwe_quote: does not authenticate or authorize visitors before displaying information about the system such as server software, php version and full file system path to the site.

AV.quote: does not authenticate or authorize visitors before displaying information about the system

PR.quote: does not authenticate or authorize visitors before displaying information about the system

C.quote: displaying information about the system such as server software, php version and full file system path to the site.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the exposure by requesting the relevant Duplicator plugin endpoint on a test site running a vulnerable version and confirm the exact fields returned; then coordinate disclosure with the vendor and recommend updating to >= 1.4.7 or applying an access control check to restrict this information to authenticated admin users.
